blocks.text: Nitrogen ke oxides NO, N2O, NO2, N2O4 aur N2O5 hain, jin mein nitrogen ki oxidation states +1 se +5 tak hain. N2O4 aur N2O5 jaldi doosre oxides mein toot jate hain. NO aur NO2 ko mil kar NOx kehte hain. Un ki banawat, khusoosiyat aur istemalat Table 12.2 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: nitrogen ke oxides ki table oxidation state, khusoosiyat aur istemalat ke saath, aur bhoore-be-rang NO2 se N2O4 equilibrium. Oopar daen: NOx ke qudrati aur insani zaraye. Darmiyan baen: nitrogen aur oxygen se ozone aur peroxyacyl nitrate tak smog reactions ki zanjeer. Darmiyan daen: chhatte jaisa converter jis mein exhaust gases dakhil aur saaf gases kharij hoti hain, aur us ke teen redox muadle. Neeche: nitrification aur denitrification apne muadlon aur halaat ke saath.
blocks.caption: Nitrogen ke oxides, un ke zaraye, photochemical smog aur PAN, three-way catalytic converter, aur nitrogen cycle (Table 12.2, Figures 12.4 se 12.6 aur Table 12.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nitrogen meethi laughing gas N2O se paramagnetic NO se ho kar surkh-bhoore NO2 tak oxides banati hai jo thanda hone par be-rang N2O4 mein dimerise hota hai. Bijli ki kaundh aur mitti ke bacteria qudrati taur par nitrogen oxides banate hain, magar zyada tar engines aur power stations mein fossil fuels jalne se aate hain. Dhoop mein nitrogen dioxide toot kar oxygen atoms deta hai jo ozone banate hain, ozone hydrocarbons ko aldehydes mein oxidise karti hai, aur yeh acyl aur peroxyacyl radicals se guzar kar nitrogen dioxide se mil kar photochemical smog ke aankh jalane wale peroxyacyl nitrates banate hain. Three-way catalytic converter chhatte par platinum, palladium aur rhodium se nitric oxide ko carbon monoxide se reduce aur carbon monoxide aur hydrocarbons ko oxidise karta hai. Mitti mein aerobic bacteria ammonium ko paudon ke liye nitrite aur nitrate mein oxidise karte hain, aur anaerobic bacteria nitrate ko wapas nitrogen gas mein reduce karte hain.

blocks.prompt: N2O, NO aur NO2 ki banawat banayein aur un ki bonding mukhtasar wazeh karein (Quick Check 12.2a).
blocks.explanation: N2O linear hai, N=N=O (ya N-N triple bond O- ke saath), nitrogen +1 mein. NO mein electrons ki taq tadaad hai: N=O double bond nitrogen par ek unpaired electron ke saath, is liye paramagnetic, aur yeh kamzori se N2O2 mein dimerise hota hai. NO2 mura hua hai, O-N=O delocalised bond aur nitrogen par unpaired electron (paramagnetic) ke saath, jo do molecules ke N-N se jurne par jora ban kar N2O4 deta hai.

items: Oxides NO, N2O, NO2, N2O4, N2O5 (N +1 se +5); N2O4 aur N2O5 toot jate hain; NOx = NO + NO2.
N2O (+1): meethi, anaesthetic, propellant. NO (+2): paramagnetic, paighambar. NO2 (+4): surkh-bhoori, pani se HNO3 + HNO2, 2NO2 = N2O4 be-rang; rocket propellant, Ostwald process.
